fact: The Ministry of Economy and the Instituto Nacional de Normalizacao e Qualidade (INNOQ, IP) announced on 7 May 2026 that a Certificate of Conformity under the Conformity Assessment Programme of Decree 8/2022 becomes mandatory from 1 June 2026 for listed imports (rice, fortified foods, used vehicles, tyres, construction steel); the document states no IT or data standard.

The Instituto Nacional de Normalizacao e Qualidade (INNOQ) is named as the national body that awarded an ISO 9001:2015 certificate to the National Institute of Health's finance area on 16 March 2026; the document names no IT or data standard.

Decree 8/2022 of 14 March 2022 (Council of Ministers) approves the Regulation on Standardisation and Conformity Assessment and gives the Instituto Nacional de Normalizacao e Qualidade (INNOQ, IP) the job of coordinating standardisation, implementing Mozambican Technical Standards and certifying management systems, products, services and people against them; the passages shown name no IT or data standard.
